Concrete slabs & subfloors

Concrete slabs & subfloors

How Do You Test a Concrete Slab for Moisture Before Installing Flooring?

Slabs are tested with ASTM F2170 relative humidity probes or F1869 calcium chloride; the default limit is 75% RH or 3 lbs per 1,000 sq ft.

Read the answer →
Concrete slabs & subfloors

Do I Need a Moisture Barrier Under Vinyl Plank on a Concrete Slab?

Often, yes -- most vinyl plank makers still cap slab moisture near 75-90% RH, and some SPC lines allow more only with a vapor barrier.

Read the answer →
Concrete slabs & subfloors

Can You Install Hardwood Flooring Directly on a Concrete Slab?

Engineered hardwood can glue directly to a slab that passes its moisture test; solid hardwood usually needs a plywood subfloor first.

Read the answer →
Concrete slabs & subfloors

Is Glue-Down or Floating Better for Floors on a Florida Concrete Slab?

Glue-down suits high-traffic and high-moisture rooms; floating installs faster but many condos, like Siesta Key's, restrict it above floor one.

Read the answer →
Concrete slabs & subfloors

How Flat Does a Concrete Floor Need to Be for Vinyl Plank Flooring?

Most SPC vinyl plank guides require a slab flat within 3/16 in. over 10 ft; self-leveling typically runs about $250-$700 per room in 2026.
